## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Invite validation should enforce the stated twelve-character minimum so users cannot set shorter passwords through invitations.

## Changes

The pull request raises the signup and reset password minimum from eight to twelve characters and updates the boundary tests for both validators.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- PR body — correctness — Apply the twelve-character minimum to invites — An 11-character invite password still passes validation despite the PR body’s stated twelve-character requirement. `app/invite.py:1` still sets the minimum to eight. — Users accepting an invitation can set passwords of eight to eleven characters. — Fix: Raise the minimum in `app/invite.py:1` and update `test_password_boundaries` in `tests/test_invite.py`.
